REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JANUARY 26, 2017 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT HELD ON JANUARY 26,
2017, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125 BLOOMFIELD
AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by the Star Hoopers Rookie III Basketball team.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in
  attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Carol Chen
  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor/Chair George Ray

  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Naresh Solanki was noted as absent from the meeting.

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  None.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Norbert Chen spoke in opposition to the City’s policy on short-term rentals.

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by
  one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a
  Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be
  removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of
  January 12, 2017 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of January 12, 2017
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  January 26, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 6

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated January 26,
  2017 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the
  Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated January 26, 2017 in the
  amount of $3,132,170.42 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos
  Redevelopment Agency dated January 26, 2017 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the
  Register of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos Redevelopment
  Agency dated January 26, 2017 in the amount of $3,782,650.41 (SUCCESSOR
  AGENCY). The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and introduce AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING CHAPTER 22.30 OF THE
  CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO BUILDING SETBACK
  REQUIREMENTS WITHIN OPEN SPACE (OS) ZONED AREAS, HEREIN
  REFERENCED AS DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2017-1(COUNCIL).*

  The public hearings for Items 8A and 8B were conducted concurrently
  pursuant to City Council consensus.

  Staff reports were given by Kristin Aguila, Advance Planning Manager,
  Sandy Cisneros, Senior Planner, and Robert A. Lopez, Current Planning
  Manager. A PowerPoint Presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public hearings and public comments.

  Ron Taylor, Superintendent of Valley Christian School, commented on the
  project.

  Derek Stemrich, the project’s architect, commented on the project.

  Sally Havice spoke in support of the project.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed
  public comments.
 City of Cerritos  January 26, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 6

8.  Public Hearings (continued)

8A.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Pulido, to:

  1. Approve Development Code Amendment 2017-1, making the findings set forth
  in Cerritos Planning Commission Resolution No. 2017-2; and
  2. Waive full reading of and introduce Ordinance No. 1011, AN ORDINANCE OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING CHAPTER 22.30 OF THE CERRITOS
  MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO BUILDING SETBACK REQUIREMENTS
  WITHIN OPEN SPACE (OS) ZONED AREAS, HEREIN REFERENCED AS
  DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2017-1 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (4
  – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

8B.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT 2003-1(D)(2017)
  AMENDMENT, A REQUEST BY PROPERTY OWNER VALLEY CHRISTIAN SCHOOL
  SYSTEM TO PERMIT ONE (1) HIGH SCHOOL GYMNASIUM AND THREE (3)
  ACCESSORY BUILDINGS UNDER PHASE III OF THE MASTER PLAN OF DEVELOPMENT
  FOR THE CAMPUS LOCATED AT 10818 ARTESIA BOULEVARD AND 17601 DUMONT
  AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTIES ARE ZONED
  OPEN SPACE (OS) (APNS 7034-017-035, 7034-017-036 AND 7034-018-115)
  (COUNCIL).*

  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2003-1(D)(2017) AMENDMENT, A
  PROPOSAL BY PROPERT OWNER VALLEY CHRISTIAN SCHOOL SYSTEM TO
  CONSTRUCT ONE (1) HIGH SCHOOL GYMNASIUM AND THREE (3) ACCESSORY
  BUILDINGS UNDER PHASE III OF THE CAMPUS MASTER PLAN OF DEVELOPMENT.
  THE PROPOSAL INCLUDES NEW LANDSCAPING AND HARDSCAPE ADJACENT TO THE
  FOUR (4) BUILDINGS LOCATED AT 10818 ARTESIA BOULEVARD AND 17601
  DUMONT AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTIES ARE
  ZONED OPEN SPACE (OS) (APN 7034-017-035, 7034-017-036 AND 7034-018-115)
  (COUNCIL).*

  *One Mitigated Negative Declaration was prepared in accordance with the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) and was previously adopted on February 27,
  2003, for Conditional Use Permit 2003-1 and Precise Plan 2003-1.

  The public hearings for Items 8A and 8B were conducted concurrently pursuant to
  City Council consensus. Please see Item 8A for public comments.
 City of Cerritos  January 26, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 6

8.  Public Hearings (continued)

8B.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Pulido, to waive full reading of
  and adopt:

  1. Resolution No. 2017-01, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  APPROVING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT 2003-1(D)(2017) AMENDMENT,
  A REQUEST BY PROPERTY OWNER VALLEY CHRISTIAN SCHOOL SYSTEM
  TO PERMIT ONE (1) HIGH SCHOOL GYMNASIUM AND THREE (3)
  ACCESSORY BUILDINGS UNDER PHASE III OF THE MASTER PLAN OF
  DEVELOPMENT FOR THE CAMPUS LOCATED AT 10818 ARTESIA
  BOULEVARD AND 17601 DUMONT AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA,
  90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTIES ARE ZONED OPEN SPACE (OS) (APNS
  7034-017-035, 7034-017-036 AND 7034-018-115) (COUNCIL).
  2. Resolution No. 2017-02, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2003-1(D)(2017) AMENDMENT, A
  PROPOSAL BY PROPERT OWNER VALLEY CHRISTIAN SCHOOL SYSTEM
  TO CONSTRUCT ONE (1) HIGH SCHOOL GYMNASIUM AND THREE (3)
  ACCESSORY BUILDINGS UNDER PHASE III OF THE CAMPUS MASTER
  PLAN OF DEVELOPMENT.  THE PROPOSAL INCLUDES NEW
  LANDSCAPING AND HARDSCAPE ADJACENT TO THE FOUR (4)
  BUILDINGS LOCATED AT 10818 ARTESIA BOULEVARD AND 17601
  DUMONT AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT
  PROPERTIES ARE ZONED OPEN SPACE (OS) (APN 7034-017-035, 7034-
  017-036 AND 7034-018-115)(COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS REPEALING RESOLUTION NO. 2000-49
  AND ADOPTING AN UPDATED CITY-WIDE RECORDS RETENTION SCHEDULE
  (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk. A PowerPoint Presentation
  was displayed.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Chen, and seconded by Pulido, to waive full reading of
  and adopt Resolution No. 2017-03, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS REPEALING RESOLUTION NO. 2000-49 AND
  ADOPTING AN UPDATED CITY-WIDE RECORDS RETENTION SCHEDULE as
  amended (COUNCIL). The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  January 26, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 5 of 6

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9B.  Review and consideration of an award of contract for Request for Proposals No.
  1270-17, city-wide electronic content management system/document imaging
  (archive and retrieve) and conversion of database – existing LibertyNet system
  (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk. A PowerPoint Presentation
  was displayed.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Anantha Ramachandran inquired regarding the technical specifications of the
  Request for Proposals.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed
  public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Chen, and seconded by Pulido, to:

  1. Award a contract for the purchase of an Electronic Content Management
  System/Document Imaging and Management System (archive & retrieve) and
  the conversion of the existing LibertyNet system database to Complete Paperless
  Solutions in the amount of $67,867.00; and
  2. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute the contract and any
  contract modifications that may be necessary to complete the specified scope of
  work (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal Legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.

  Reports were provided by Councilmembers Edwards, Pulido, and Chen, and

  CONSENSUS (Chen): Directed staff to provide clarification between ABC
  Unified’s stated bond debt compared to the information stated in the City’s
